This '''attack''' matched the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Vallaido Clan|Vallaido pirate clan]] against its longtime enemy, the [[Seville Family|Seville pirate clan]]. As the Sevilles were reinforced by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]], they were able to obliterate the Vallaidos.

==History==
The [[Seville Family]] and the [[Vallaido Clan]] had been rival [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organizations for many generations by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As their enmity was well-known, no one was surprised when one clan's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] attacked the other.<ref name="CRO-" />

At that point, the Seville pirate clan was led by [[Yearo Seville]], who made a deal with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Under this alliance, the Seville fleet had Imperial starships as reinforcements. With this firepower, the Sevilles attacked the Vallaido fleet. Overwhelmed, the Vallaido fleet was destroyed.<ref name="CRO-" />

The man named [[Siro Simito]], a former member of the Vallaido pirate clan, was aghast when he discovered this. Simito then joined the anti-Imperial [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and began working as an undercover agent for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]].<ref name="CRO-" />
